# Native text conversion libraries

Compiled-in Markdown/HTML conversion uses pulldown-cmark 0.13.6, htmd 0.5.6, html5ever/markup5ever/xml5ever 0.38.0, markup5ever_rcdom 0.38.0+unofficial, pulldown-cmark-escape 0.11.0 and unicase 2.10.0. Exact dependency checksums are retained in Cargo.lock. The accompanying crate license files preserve upstream notices. These libraries are distributed under their included MIT and/or Apache-2.0 terms; the application license is unchanged.

Source: https://crates.io/crates/pulldown-cmark/0.13.6 and https://crates.io/crates/htmd/0.5.6; the other exact crate sources are identified by Cargo.lock. No LibreOffice runtime is included by this native provider.
